Deal: Apollo-owned New Home Co., through Lido Holdco / Lido Merger Sub, bought Landsea for $11.30 a share in cash (about $1.2B enterprise value, 61% premium). Deal: Closed 2025-02-10 (previously announced). Lennar gained new markets in Arkansas (including Bentonville/Fayetteville and Little Rock), Tulsa, Birmingham and Kansas City. Deal: Perry Homes bought MasterCraft Builder Group, a Jacksonville-area builder founded in 2011 by Chris Shee and run with his brother Brad Shee. Terms were not disclosed. Builder Advisor Group advised the seller. Perry keeps the MasterCraft Builder Group brand in select Jacksonville communities.
Source: Perry Homes Announces Acquisition of Florida-Based MasterCraft Builder Group (2024-12-03)
What it changes in the map: Creates Perry's Jacksonville / Northeast Florida division, its fifth Florida market. Brad Shee is quoted in October 2026 as Division President for Perry Homes in Jacksonville, so the seller's co-founder now runs the division. A Florida entity, Perry Homes of Florida LLC, is taking down finished lots in Clay County (40 lots at Creekview Trail in 2026). Deal price, lots and backlog acquired are not public.
Research note: Announced one month before the 2025 window; included because it is Perry's only acquisition on record and defines the Florida map. Also reported by the Jacksonville Daily Record (2024-12-03, 'terms of the deal were not disclosed') and listed on Builder Advisor Group's site as a December 2024 sell-side mandate.

Target: Willowdale Asset Management / Precedent Land Company (internal reorganisation)

Source: Davidson's M&A-Organic Combo Speeds San Antonio Scale (HousingWire / The Builder's Daily, 2024-03-13)
